name: Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale, Screen Version - Recent
source: C-SSRS Screen Version - Recent PDF supplied by Jess Salvacion, 2026-10-20 (Columbia / New York State Psychiatric Institute)
verification_note: Question wording was compared line by line with the official Screen Version - Recent PDF and matches. The action text below comes from the Columbia ED triage-points page, not from this PDF, so it still needs a named clinician to confirm. Set verified to true only after that. Columbia asks users to follow its terms of use and training requirements.

questions.text: Have you wished you were dead or wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?
Have you actually had any thoughts of killing yourself?
Have you been thinking about how you might do this?
questions.example: E.g. "I thought about taking an overdose but I never made a specific plan as to when where or how I would actually do it....and I would never go through with it."

questions.text: Have you had these thoughts and had some intention of acting on them?
questions.example: As opposed to "I have the thoughts but I definitely will not do anything about them."

questions.text: Have you started to work out or worked out the details of how to kill yourself? Do you intend to carry out this plan?
Have you ever done anything, started to do anything, or prepared to do anything to end your life?

follow_up.text: Was this within the past 3 months?

questions.example: Examples: Collected pills, obtained a gun, gave away valuables, wrote a will or suicide note, took out pills but didn't swallow any, held a gun but changed your mind or it was grabbed from your hand, went to the roof but didn't jump; or actually took pills, tried to shoot yourself, cut yourself, tried to hang yourself, etc.
questions.risk: high if within 3 months, moderate if longer ago

actions.referral: Behavioral health referral at discharge (questions 1 to 3, or question 6 more than 3 months ago).
actions.immediate: Notify the physician and/or behavioral health now, and use patient safety precautions (questions 4 or 5, or question 6 within the past 3 months).
